top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is not notifying parents of less serious injuries.

top_violation_types.title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3505(f))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Although there is a trashcan with a lid used for diapers, several diapers were observed in another trashcan without a lid accessible to children.    NOTE: The toddler caregiver changed out the trashcan and started using the other trashcan with a lid used for diapers.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver was observed feeding two babies under 6 months at once. One laying across her lap and the other on the floor.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple infants were observed in bucket chairs without the provided straps being used.

top_violation_types.title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A childs hands were observed to not be washed after a childs diaper was changed.

top_violation_types.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.
